tools.description: Create a non-mutating behavioral proposal by applying semantic machine patches in memory through the Stately API. Returns the updated document, the structured patches, and a concise behavioral summary; it never writes files or invokes Git. Use graph entity IDs: top-level XState states commonly use <machine-id>.<state-key> (for example job.running). Use camelCase operations such as createTransition, not snake_case names.

XState source must be complete executable source (including imports) because it runs natively in an isolated sandbox. max sets page size (default 5, maximum 1000); pass nextCursor as cursor with the same input to retrieve more. Pagination distinguishes complete bounded generation from budget exhaustion; it does not establish application coverage.

tools.description: Simulate a machine through events. XState source runs in an isolated sandbox. SCXML defaults to structural mode; executionMode="native" opts into sandboxed XState v6 execution. advanceTimeMs runs virtual timers after the supplied events. Returns execution metadata and optional completion output.

tools.description: Check a native statechart (XGraph or XState config) against a rules file with the bounded native explicit-state checker: never, initially, eventually, eventually-always, leads-to, no-dead-ends and reachable rules over hierarchical and parallel states and bounded context. Returns per-rule verdicts with native counterexample traces and a graph carrying the check report; save it with save_stately_check_result. Undecidable results are not-checked. Runs on the hosted API with bounded time and state limits; for TLA+ use the /stately skill's stately-check command.

tools.description: Generate a Stately diagram for a described flow by supplying an XState JSON config. Rendering is browser-free. Visualize XState source text (the default for strings), JSON machine configs, SCXML, XGraph, Mermaid, or D2. Returns a View in Stately link; hosts that support MCP Apps also render an interactive hierarchy graph inline, and auto presentation includes PNG and Unicode text fallbacks. Use presentation unicode or ascii to skip PNG generation in text-only clients. Optionally select a root view, request multiple parent views, or recompute PNG layout.
